My parents, who have lower education levels, couldn’t help much, so I rely on teachers. It’s not my favorite subject, but I try to get through it because it’s necessary for my studies.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, I often feel anxious about math. The fear of not understanding formulas or failing tests weighs on me. It’s a recurring stress, especially before exams. I wish I could be more confident, but the complexity of math just overwhelms me sometimes.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using an AI tutor last semester to help with algebra. replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, identify the equation like ax² + bx + c = 0. Then, calculate the discriminant (D = b² - 4ac).
